plot_scene_with_bboxes: plot a 3D scene with meshes, pointclouds, cameras, and bounding boxes using plotly subplots
get_bbox_wireframe: generate a wireframe tensor of 3D bounding box corner points and edges from min-max coordinates
create_triad_pointclouds: create colored 3D coordinate system triad pointclouds from rotation matrices and translation vectors
add_bbox3d_trace: add a 3D bounding box wireframe trace to a plotly figure subplot with optional color and width
add_separate_bbox3d_traces: add individual 3D bounding box traces to a plotly figure with per-box names and colors
